title: mmWave Radar
summary: See people move: a viewer for the HLK-LD2450 / LD2452 tracking radar.
description: Shows up to three people the radar tracks: a top-down plot with trails and speed arrows, a table of the raw numbers, a 30 s graph of distance and speed, and the sensor's state. Finds the radar on a USB-serial adapter by listening only: it sends nothing to the sensor. Metres and km/h, or mm and cm/s. Needs a screen of at least 480x320 (portrait 320x480 in PDA mode).
